sample_count_interpretation: 200 arms is a deliberately stricter voluntary v1-lineage choice, not an exact or unique restatement of the user minimum
checkpoint_rule: first and final observation of every gate role-sequence; all intervening observations CaptureOnly
input_verification: complete sealed input manifest verified exactly once under the owner-bound global lock before any benchmark child
clone_authority: manifest-verified immutable source plus native APFS clonefile success, exact ordered entry receipt, bytes, inventory, inode relation, and sealed 0444 to cloned 0444 to private 0600 file mode transition with 0700 private directories
logical_catalog_authority: domain-separated typed length-prefixed complete benchmark-owned logical rows in table-tag and primary-key order
full_wrapper_forecast: durably recorded by zero-row dry-run from prospectively enumerated non-hash components plus exact scheduled external hash bytes at no more than half the slower observed Python/external-shasum throughput
hash_calibration_floor: min(Python SHA-256 bytes/s, external shasum bytes/s) divided by two
forecast_failure_disposition: durable PREMEASUREMENT_REVISE with no row reduction
v8_original_dry_run_artifact: Unavailable: v8 raised before writing DRY-RUN-v8.json
v8_forecast_values: retained read-only diagnostic reconstruction, not an authoritative v8 dry-run artifact
python_cache_policy: __pycache__ is generated non-authoritative residue and is not deleted as history
frozen_g4_transport: one-shot-only; launch and internal custody are complete-arm work, and only common internal intervals decide overhead
g5_transport_requirement: one persistent child per mode/size/operation arm with immutable Store integrity mode
